passages.exact_excerpt: Author one development skill and return a manual request for skill-validator. A clear current request authorizes creation or focused editing without a separately approved specification. Record requirements before generating files. Validation and testing belong to skill-validator; do not run structural checkers, graders, test suites, generated scripts as samples, cold trials, or automatic validator calls. Do not generate executable test campaigns during authoring. Further authorized edits may proceed while quality remains unperformed.
passages.intended_effect: Keep quality work assigned to validator
Bound captures and reject unsafe boundaries

passages.exact_excerpt: Before the first write recheck all captured current bytes and original input references; recheck each changed path immediately before mutation. On drift stop remaining writes. Record actual applied_paths and after bytes as PARTIAL when any mutation occurred. Retain failed capture/publication attempts and start a fresh linked run for retries, using the last successful baseline. No automatic rollback.

| Other metadata | Preserve useful fields supported by the target and its required structural checker. Move unsupported top-level fields into the conversion record; retain compatibility requirements in the instructions when the checker does not accept a `compatibility` field. |

limitations: Emphasis, MUST wording and checklists alone were not treated as defects.
